title: Argus Log Event
description: Structured log event schema for the Argus observability framework. Conforms to the OpenTelemetry Log Data Model (https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/otel/logs/data-model/) and W3C Trace Context (https://www.w3.org/TR/trace-context/). Each log record represents one structured event emitted by ArgusLogger.

otelTimestamp.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 timestamp with sub-second precision. Nanosecond resolution is preferred (e.g. 2024-01-15T10:30:00.000000000Z). Conforms to W3C Date and Time Formats Note.

w3cTraceId.description: W3C Trace Context trace-id: a 16-byte (128-bit) unique identifier encoded as 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters. All-zeros value (00000000000000000000000000000000) is invalid per the spec.

w3cSpanId.description: W3C Trace Context parent-id (span-id): an 8-byte (64-bit) identifier encoded as 16 lowercase hexadecimal characters. All-zeros value (0000000000000000) is invalid per the spec.

w3cTraceFlags.description: W3C Trace Context trace-flags byte. Bit 0 (value 1) is the 'sampled' flag. Remaining bits are reserved.

severityNumber.description: OTel Log Data Model SeverityNumber. Numeric levels: TRACE=1–4, DEBUG=5–8, INFO=9–12, WARN=13–16, ERROR=17–20, FATAL=21–24. Argus uses the canonical levels: DEBUG=5, INFO=9, WARN=13, ERROR=17.

severityText.description: Human-readable severity label per OTel SeverityText convention. Must be consistent with severityNumber.

resource.description: OTel Resource: entity producing the log. Populated from OTEL_SERVICE_NAME, OTEL_SERVICE_VERSION, and DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT environment variables.

service.name.description: Logical name of the service. OTel semantic convention: service.name.

service.version.description: Release version of the service. OTel semantic convention: service.version.

deployment.environment.name.description: Deployment environment name (e.g. production, staging, development). OTel semantic convention: deployment.environment.name.

instrumentationScope.description: OTel InstrumentationScope identifying the instrumentation library that emitted the log.

eventName.description: OTel EventName — the canonical dot-separated identifier for this class of log event. Set as the event.name attribute; collectors map it to the OTel LogRecord EventName field per the Log Data Model spec.

httpOutcome.description: Outcome of an inbound or outbound HTTP request.

dataOutcome.description: Outcome of a data-store or cache operation.

asyncOutcome.description: Outcome of async or event-driven message processing.

businessOutcome.description: Outcome of a business-logic step or workflow node.

errorEnvelopeProperties.description: Error context fields automatically appended to every WARN and ERROR event. The framework populates them from a Throwable when ArgusLogger.emit(event, throwable) is called.

exception.type.description: Fully-qualified class name of the thrown exception (e.g. java.net.SocketTimeoutException). OTel exception semantic convention: exception.type.

exception.message.description: Exception detail message from Throwable.getMessage(). OTel exception semantic convention: exception.message.

exception.stacktrace.description: Full stack trace as a single string, truncated to maxLength when necessary. OTel exception semantic convention: exception.stacktrace.

error.type.description: Short error category for grouping and alerting (e.g. TimeoutError, ValidationError). OTel error.type semantic convention.

timestamp.description: Nanosecond-precision timestamp at which the event was emitted. OTel Log Data Model: Timestamp.

observed_timestamp.description: Timestamp at which the OTel SDK observed the log record. May differ from timestamp when records are buffered. OTel Log Data Model: ObservedTimestamp.

severity_number.description: Numeric severity level. OTel Log Data Model: SeverityNumber.

severity_text.description: Human-readable severity label. OTel Log Data Model: SeverityText. Must be consistent with severity_number.

trace_id.description: W3C Trace Context trace-id. Present only when a span is active at emit time. OTel Log Data Model: TraceId.

span_id.description: W3C Trace Context parent-id (span-id) of the active span. OTel Log Data Model: SpanId.

trace_flags.description: W3C Trace Context trace-flags byte of the active span. OTel Log Data Model: TraceFlags.

event_name.description: Canonical event type identifier. Stored as the event.name attribute and mapped to the OTel LogRecord EventName field by collectors.

body.description: Rendered human-readable log message produced from the event body template. OTel Log Data Model: Body (AnyValue/string).

attributes.description: Event-specific OTel attributes. Attribute names follow OTel semantic conventions (dot-separated). Domain-specific required and optional fields are enforced by the event_name discriminator in the allOf conditions below.

allOf.description: W3C Trace Context constraint: trace_id and span_id must both be present or both be absent.
Severity consistency: severity_number in the INFO band (9–12) requires severity_text to start with INFO.
Severity consistency: severity_number in the DEBUG band (5–8) requires severity_text to start with DEBUG.
Severity consistency: severity_number in the WARN band (13–16) requires severity_text to start with WARN.
Severity consistency: severity_number in the ERROR band (17–20) requires severity_text to start with ERROR.
ERROR and WARN events: when error envelope fields are present, they must conform to the errorEnvelopeProperties schema.
Domain: http.request.completed — inbound HTTP request completed normally (INFO).

http.method.description: HTTP request method in uppercase (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, etc.). OTel: http.request.method.

http.response.status_code.description: HTTP response status code. OTel: http.response.status_code.

outcome.reason.description: Optional human-readable explanation of the outcome.

allOf.description: Domain: http.client.request.completed — outbound HTTP call to an upstream service completed normally (INFO).

server.address.description: Domain name or IP address of the upstream server. OTel: server.address.

http.route.description: URL path or route template of the upstream call. OTel: http.route.

http.response.status_code.description: HTTP response status code received from the upstream. OTel: http.response.status_code.

outcome.reason.description: Optional explanation of the HTTP outcome.

allOf.description: Domain: http.request.failed — HTTP request failed with an unhandled exception or fatal error (ERROR). Requires error envelope.

error.type.description: Short error category for alerting (e.g. TimeoutError, InternalError). OTel: error.type.

exception.type.description: FQCN of the thrown exception. OTel exception convention: exception.type.

exception.message.description: Exception detail message. OTel exception convention: exception.message.

exception.stacktrace.description: Full stack trace string. OTel exception convention: exception.stacktrace.

allOf.description: Domain: db.operation.executed — database query or command executed (DEBUG).

db.operation.name.description: Database operation name (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, FIND, etc.). OTel: db.operation.name.

db.collection.name.description: Table, collection, or key-space being accessed. OTel: db.collection.name.

rows.affected.description: Number of rows or documents affected or returned.

db.system.description: Database technology identifier (postgresql, mysql, mongodb, redis). OTel: db.system.

db.namespace.description: Database name or schema. OTel: db.namespace.

outcome.reason.description: Optional explanation of the data outcome.

allOf.description: Domain: db.operation.failed — database operation failed with an unhandled exception (ERROR). Requires error envelope.

db.operation.name.description: Database operation that failed. OTel: db.operation.name.

db.collection.name.description: Target table or collection. OTel: db.collection.name.

error.type.description: Short error category (e.g. ConnectionFailure, QueryTimeout). OTel: error.type.

db.namespace.description: Database name or schema. OTel: db.namespace.

exception.type.description: FQCN of the thrown exception. OTel exception convention: exception.type.

exception.message.description: Exception detail message. OTel exception convention: exception.message.

exception.stacktrace.description: Full stack trace string. OTel exception convention: exception.stacktrace.

allOf.description: Domain: cache.operation.result — cache read or write completed (DEBUG).

cache.operation.description: Cache operation type (GET, SET, DELETE, EVICT, etc.).

cache.key.prefix.description: Key prefix or namespace used for the cache lookup. Logged as a prefix (not the full key) to avoid PII exposure.

allOf.description: Domain: async.event.processed — async message or domain event was processed (INFO).

event.type.description: Domain event type identifier (e.g. order.created, payment.processed). OTel CloudEvents: event.type.

event.source.description: Source service or system that produced the event. OTel CloudEvents: event.source.

event.id.description: Unique identifier of the event, if available. OTel CloudEvents: event.id.

outcome.reason.description: Optional explanation of the processing outcome.

retry.count.description: Number of processing attempts made before this result, zero on first attempt.

messaging.destination.description: Queue, topic, or subscription from which the message was consumed. OTel: messaging.destination.name.

allOf.description: Domain: async.event.published — domain event was published to a message broker (INFO).

event.type.description: Domain event type identifier. OTel CloudEvents: event.type.

event.id.description: Unique identifier assigned to the published event. OTel CloudEvents: event.id.

messaging.destination.description: Queue, topic, or channel the event was published to. OTel: messaging.destination.name.

outcome.reason.description: Optional explanation of the publish outcome.

allOf.description: Domain: async.event.failed — async event could not be processed and will not be retried (ERROR). Requires error envelope.

event.type.description: Domain event type identifier. OTel CloudEvents: event.type.

event.source.description: Source system that produced the failed event. OTel CloudEvents: event.source.

event.id.description: Unique identifier of the failed event.

retry.count.description: Total number of processing attempts made before the terminal failure.

error.type.description: Short error category (e.g. DeserializationError, BusinessRuleViolation). OTel: error.type.

exception.type.description: FQCN of the thrown exception. OTel exception convention: exception.type.

exception.message.description: Exception detail message. OTel exception convention: exception.message.

exception.stacktrace.description: Full stack trace string. OTel exception convention: exception.stacktrace.

allOf.description: Domain: business.step.completed — named business-logic step or workflow node completed (INFO).

step.name.description: Name of the business-logic step or processing node.

flow.name.description: Name of the enclosing workflow or saga.

entity.type.description: Type of the business entity being processed (e.g. Order, Payment, User).

entity.id.description: Identifier of the specific entity instance.

outcome.reason.description: Optional explanation of the business outcome.

allOf.description: Domain: business.rule.evaluated — business rule or policy was evaluated (DEBUG).

rule.name.description: Name of the business rule or policy being evaluated.

entity.type.description: Type of the entity the rule was evaluated against.

entity.id.description: Identifier of the specific entity instance.

outcome.reason.description: Optional explanation of the rule evaluation outcome.

allOf.description: Domain: business.step.failed — business-logic step failed with an unhandled exception (ERROR). Requires error envelope.

step.name.description: Name of the failed business-logic step.

flow.name.description: Name of the enclosing workflow or saga.

entity.type.description: Type of the business entity being processed when the failure occurred.

entity.id.description: Identifier of the specific entity instance.

error.type.description: Short error category (e.g. ValidationError, IntegrationError). OTel: error.type.

exception.type.description: FQCN of the thrown exception. OTel exception convention: exception.type.

exception.message.description: Exception detail message. OTel exception convention: exception.message.

exception.stacktrace.description: Full stack trace string. OTel exception convention: exception.stacktrace.
